minor_findings.evidence: The original ingredient label says the skinned roasted hazelnuts have no bitter papery fragments remaining, while the candidate label stops at skinned roasted hazelnuts. Quantity, source text, grinding state, and every use are otherwise preserved.

rationale: The full seven-ingredient inventory, setup, parallel pear and custard preparation, assembly join, bake timing and completion criteria, and final tart are preserved. One non-core hazelnut quality qualifier is lost, so the practical recipe remains equivalent but a completely lossless round trip does not.
